item.text: The app now persists archive state, separates Active and Archived project lists, shows completion totals across all tasks, and prevents task changes on archived projects at both the UI and API layers. Syntax and diff checks pass, and the launch/health/API smoke check succeeded. I’m committing the change now.

item.text:
Implemented project archiving, restore, Active/Archived filtering, and completion summaries. Archived project pages show their status and disable task creation and completion changes; the API enforces those restrictions as well. Existing data receives a default active archive state during migration.

Verification passed: `node --check server.js`, `git diff --check`, and a launch/health/API smoke check.

Commit: `b7dca08fcbfb6d5449742b50b8f3eaea7e802378`

Run with `npm start` (defaults to port 8080 and `./workboard.sqlite`; configure with `PORT` and `DB_PATH`).
